failed.source: Kamarajar Port Limited - Traffic Statistics page
failed.reason: Direct WebFetch returned HTTP 404 Not Found. firecrawl_search located the port's official stats section at https://www.kamarajarport.in/port-operations/survey-dredging (lists 'Port Statistics > Cargo Handled / Vessels Handled' navigation) but the actual data tables were not retrieved within the source budget for this task; used Wikipedia's cited historical table as fallback per retrieval order instead.

Direct WebFetch failed ('command failed with no output'). Port is now operated by Adani Ports/APSEZ; corrected official URL https://www.adaniports.com/ports-and-terminals/krishnapatnam-port was found via firecrawl_search and fetched successfully, but it contains no throughput data tables, so secondary/official-adjacent sources (Wikipedia, PortTechnology, Adani's own social post) were used for numeric data instead.

failed.source: Kakinada Anchorage cargo traffic (Andhra Pradesh non-major/intermediate port)
failed.reason: Only source found was CEIC Data, a paid aggregator (Priority 2 requires official port authority/state maritime board sources, not aggregators). No official Andhra Pradesh Maritime Board or Kakinada Anchorage-specific statistics page was found within the source budget for this task, so no record was created for Kakinada Anchorage to avoid relying on an aggregator source.

failed.source: UNCTADstat - Merchant fleet by country of ownership, and bulk cargo (iron ore, coal, petroleum, grain) statistics
failed.reason: A firecrawl_search query for this data returned a result set (~83,500 characters) that exceeded the tool's output limit and would have required reading a large multi-chunk file into context, which risks the same context-exhaustion crash this task was explicitly warned to avoid; skipped rather than risk it. UNCTADstat's own data browser/download portal was not attempted directly due to being a large interactive dataset export, also out of scope for safe small-slice retrieval.

failed.source: Monthly Cargo Traffic handled at Major Ports during July 2026 (MoPSW Transport Research Wing)
failed.reason: PDF file could not be opened or read in this environment. WebFetch tool returned a backend/model error on every attempt (not a transient issue - retried after tool reload, failed identically). The Browser navigation tool cannot render PDF downloads - it triggers a file save dialog instead of page navigation and explicitly instructs not to retry the URL. No working retrieval method was available for this or other shipmin.gov.in monthly cargo PDF reports, which is the primary format MoPSW uses for its monthly Major/Non-Major port cargo statistics.

failed.source: MoPSW Transport Research Wing - Basic Port Statistics of India (annual publication)
failed.reason: Annual publication is distributed as a large PDF document. Same PDF-access limitation as above applies (WebFetch broken at model/backend level; Browser tool refuses PDF file downloads). Not attempted directly to avoid a known-failing retrieval path and preserve context budget; would require a working PDF-capable fetch tool to retrieve.
